propositions: AcliClient._search_cache memoizes search results per JQL indefinitely with no TTL or invalidation, caching negative results permanently and causing stale answers on re-query

Existing callers reach into the private _search_cache attribute directly to evict entries before retry (access_check.py and _fresh_search), violating encapsulation and leaving the freshness contract undocumented
An AcliClient instance lives for exactly one reconcile pass, so a public invalidate_search_cache(jql=None) method can serve as the supported freshness door
The negative-caching hazard must be documented in search_issues, and both reach-in sites must migrate to the public door via callable-guarded lookup
binding_recovery.py cross-pass miss corroboration is unaffected because each pass constructs a fresh client with a fresh memo, making repeated queries genuinely fresh
